name: Obsidian the Elder
summary: Obsidian the Elder is an encounter with an ancestral spirit during the Lunar Festival. Situated in Silverpine Forest near the Sepulcher, he honors travelers who come to pay homage to the ancient traditions of Azeroth. Visiting him provides a Coin of Ancestry and his blessing.

sections.title: A Spirit in the Shadow of the Sepulcher
sections.body: Amid the blighted pine woods and desolate tombs of Silverpine Forest, the presence of Elder Obsidian offers a rare moment of peace. Positioned just beside the cemetery at the Sepulcher, this spectral elder watches over a region caught between the shadows of the Forsaken and the feral beasts of the wild. He greets those who approach not as faction warriors, but as wayfarers honoring ancient wisdom.

sections.title: Veneration of the Ancestors
sections.body: Elder Obsidian is part of the Cenarion Circle's annual Lunar Festival, a time dedicated to honoring the elders who shaped Azeroth in ages past. Travelers who seek him out receive a Coin of Ancestry and his heartfelt praise for continuing to venerate the olden races, proving that even in grim, plague-touched corners of the world, older traditions endure.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Obsidian?
faq.answer: Elder Obsidian stands just to the right of the cemetery in the Sepulcher, the primary Horde outpost in central Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out Elder Obsidian?
faq.answer: Visiting Elder Obsidian completes a holiday task for the Lunar Festival, granting a Coin of Ancestry and festive favor from the ancient elders.

faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Elder Obsidian?
faq.answer: While the Sepulcher is a heavily fortified Horde settlement, Lunar Festival elders are generally peaceful to all who pay homage. However, Alliance travelers must brave the hostile Forsaken guards stationed nearby.

faq.q: Who are the elders during the Lunar Festival?
faq.answer: The elders are spectral projections and spirits of respected ancestors from ancient races. During the Lunar Festival, they manifest across Azeroth to share their wisdom and reward those who honor history.

faq.q: Why is an elder present in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: The elders appear across all corners of Azeroth to remind mortals of the ancient world before modern conflicts. Even in lands newly claimed by the Forsaken, elder spirits persist.

faq.q: What are Coins of Ancestry used for?
faq.answer: Coins of Ancestry earned from elders like Obsidian can be brought to Lunar Festival emissaries in Moonglade and capital cities to trade for festive garments, recipes, and seasonal trinkets.

angles.text: Resting right beside the Sepulcher cemetery, Elder Obsidian is exceptionally easy and safe for Horde members questing through Silverpine to visit.
Alliance wanderers seeking Elder Obsidian's blessing must sneak or fight their way deep into the heart of Silverpine Forest and skirt the Forsaken guards at the Sepulcher.
Elder Obsidian offers a poignant contrast to the grim reality of the Sepulcher, acknowledging that travelers still recognize the olden races despite the tragedies that befell Lordaeron.
As emissaries aligned with the Cenarion Circle's seasonal celebrations, honoring elders like Obsidian reflects the druidic commitment to remembering the ancient world.
